The '''2022 ATP Masters 1000''' season is the thirty-third edition of the [[ATP Masters]] Series of tennis tournaments.<ref>{{Cite web |title=2022 ATP Calendar |url=https://www.atptour.com/-/media/files/2022-atp-challenger-calendar-as-of-3-3-2022.pdf?sc=0&hash=43FF6A72BC0DE1AD17A6BC264DAD0083 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20220306142518/https://www.atptour.com/en/tournaments |archive-date=6 March 2022 |access-date= |website=[[ATP Tour]] }}</ref> The champion of each ATP 1000 event is awarded 1,000 rankings points.
